arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Young stated the underlying facts are important before addressing mootness.
Mr. Young argued the notice must comport with the district court judgment.
Mr. Collins suggested vacating the court of appeals decision to reinstate the lower judgment.
Justice Roberts asked why the notice content inadequacy matters for opt-out elections.
